{{Top|leg}}
The '''Keepers of Artifacts''' was a title used to refer to members of the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabiting<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Te Hasa system/Legends|Te Hasa system]]</ref>
[[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TGE">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref> [[Te Hasa/Legends|Te Hasa]]<ref name="Files" /> around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which mentions the Keepers of Artifacts, is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which is dated to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
